run_doctest_operators: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python operator overloading for extension types X and Z
test_arithmetic_operators: test arithmetic operators like addition, subtraction, negation, and abs on Boost.Python extension type X
test_comparison_operators: test comparison operators less than and greater than on Boost.Python extension type X instances
test_numeric_conversions: test int, float, and complex numeric conversions on Boost.Python extension type Z
test_pow_operator: test the pow built-in function with Boost.Python extension type X as base or exponent
